description:
What is This Part?
This is the Inner Timing Cover Gasket Kit
INCLUDES Inner Timing Cover Gasket, Timing Belt Inspection Plug, Water Pump Gaskets, Rubber Hole Grommets & Metal Sleeves
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Inner Timing Cover Gasket
Qty 1 – Timing Belt Inspection Plug
Qty 4 – Water Pump Gaskets
Qty 2 – Rubber Hole Grommets
Qty 2 – Metal Sleeves
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
